newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds start quietly easier.
newsitem.headline: European feeds start quietly easier.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market opened quietly ahead of the weekend with sellers offering most products unchanged to a few dollars lower following last night's easier Chicago soymeal futures close, dealers said.
Bids were scarce and no trades were reported during the initial stages of the market.

"There is little faith in the market despite the easier seller prices. The dollar is slightly firmer and many dealers who were absent yesterday due to May Day were not in today either, bridging to the weekend," one broker said.
Afloat Thai tapioca pellets changed hands between 19 and 19.45 marks per 100 kg fob Rotterdam from several vessels.
May EU rapemeal traded at 30.75 marks per 100 kg fob lower Rhine.
No trades were reported in other products.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
